outcome: length of Intensive Maternal Unit stay
length of stay in Neonatal ICU
cohort: 17,185 obstetric admissions, with 841 admitted to the Intensive Maternal Unit of a tertiary hospital in Manila from January 2017 to December 2019
finding: Pregnancy-associated hypertensive disease was the most common cause of admission to the IMU, and cesarean section was the most common surgical intervention.
mod_finding: 54.49% of patients admitted to the IMU underwent cesarean section.
